name: Why Compilers Rarely Use Strassen's Algorithm

mentions.name: Why Compilers Rarely Use Strassen's Algorithm
mentions.description: This article examines why compilers rarely use Strassen's algorithm for matrix multiplication, part of the author's research into matmul algorithms and their hardware implementations as groundwork toward starting a hardware startup.
mentions.problem: Despite faster alternatives existing, the naive O(n^3) matrix multiplication algorithm is what everyone uses, as compilers rarely adopt Strassen's algorithm.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I was looking at matmul algorithms and their hardware implementations (to start a hardware startup) and I saw that the naive O(n^3) version is what everyone uses.

https://leetarxiv.substack.com/p/why-compilers-rarely-use-strassens-algorithm
